# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Link        https://www.hackerrank.com/challenges/designer-door-mat/problem?isFullScreen=true
# Problem     Designer Door Mat
# Difficulty  Easy
# Subdomain   Strings
# Platform    HackerRank
# Language    pypy3
# Status      Accepted
# Submitted   2026-06-30, 12:21 p.m.
# Technique   string-formatting-center-method
# Time        O(N*M)
# Space       O(M)
# Insight     The pattern is generated by iterating through rows using the center method to pad strings with hyphens based on the calculated width M.
# Interview   Before: "How would you construct this symmetric pattern?" After: "I used the string center method to pad the pattern with hyphens, achieving O(N*M) time complexity, where N is the number of rows and M is the width, ensuring the WELCOME text is perfectly centered."
# Pitfalls    (1) Incorrectly calculating the number of rows as n instead of n//2 for the top and bottom sections.  (2) Failing to use the center method with the hyphen character as the fill character.  (3) Miscalculating the number of pattern repetitions as 2*i instead of 2*i+1.
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

n,m = map(int,input().split())

for i in range(n//2):
    pat = ".|." * (2*i+1)
    print(pat.center(m,'-'))
    
print("WELCOME".center(m,'-'))
    
for i in range(n//2-1,-1,-1):
    pat = ".|." * (2*i+1)
    print(pat.center(m,'-'))
